column3: “O Nineveh” is supplied; brace yourselves replaces strengthen the loins.
“Though” replaces the second for; of their vine specifies the branches.
“Shields” pluralizes shield; fittings is supplied, and spears of interprets the cypresses.
“The city” is supplied; exiled renders being uncovered, carried away renders being brought up, and breasts replaces hearts.
“It is draining away” replaces they are fleeing; they cry is supplied.
“Hearts” pluralizes heart; bodies tremble replaces anguish in all loins.
“Or” replaces and; their cubs pluralizes the cub.
“Your chariots” replaces her chariots; voices pluralizes voice.
